title: RailCloud-HdF: A Large-Scale Point Cloud Dataset for Railway Scene Semantic Segmentation
description: RailCloud-HdF is a large-scale, densely annotated LiDAR point-cloud dataset for semantic segmentation of railway scenes. It contains 5,353 LAZ scans covering eight railway lines and 267.52 km in the Hauts-de-France region of northern France.

recommended_tools.name: laspy
recommended_tools.purpose: Python access to coordinates, intensity, classification, color, GPS time, and other LAS/LAZ dimensions

recommended_tools.name: pylas
recommended_tools.purpose: Python access to LAS/LAZ point data in existing pylas workflows

intended_uses: Evaluating semantic segmentation, classification, or object-detection methods
Segmenting additional objects and annotating new classes
Cleaning, extending, improving, or completing the dataset
usage_note: RailCloud-HdF is intended for academic and research use. All uses must comply with CC BY-NC 4.0, including attribution and the prohibition on commercial use.

associated_paper.title: RailCloud-HdF: A Large-Scale Point Cloud Dataset for Railway Scene Semantic Segmentation

citation_message: If you use RailCloud-HdF in your research, please cite the associated VISAPP 2024 paper. The Zenodo DOI identifies this archived dataset release and can be used to reference the exact dataset version.
